title: Geno Smith looks good, throws opening series touchdown pass in Jets' 17-0 win over Steelers

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Geno Smith looks good, throws opening series touchdown pass in Jets' 17-0 win over Steelers
sources.description: For the second straight week, the Jets were facing a team that was resting most of its starters, but New York’s starters played well and will have gained some confidence from their first-half performance.
